authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / contributing local planning authorities
note: Previously unused official public no-login real-data source window. Planning Data reports 7,512 article-4-direction-area records from 116 data providers; the official specification defines each area as geometry for an Article 4 direction and requires a permanent reference plus Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry in WGS84. A bounded window of at most 50 candidate records was considered solely to resolve the fixed future_growth_3 partition/geography. Round64 remote readback still exposes no authoritative article-4-direction-area reference, local-authority-district/organisation identifier, local-plan reference, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, title identifier, or equivalent selector binding any candidate area to this fixed slot. Choosing an area would invent partition ownership. Therefore no coverage_area_id or Polygon/MultiPolygon is selected for this slot, no AAYS_SOURCE_AREA_V1 record is accepted, no canonical parcel is accepted, and no future_growth_new Plan0 package is emitted.
